'''Bonekrusha Heavy Armor T1''' is a {{gear|5|Armor}}gear item.

{{Item description|Designed by Endfield after referencing wildland handcrafting techniques, and assembled by the AIC. This equipment improves the wearer's combat capabilities.|Equipment with designs inspired by the Bonekrusher Clan. 
This heavy suit of armor not only provides decent protection, wildland roamers also regard it as a symbol for a brutal and merciless way of life.}}
